description: Re-checks the ownership TXT record, edge readiness, and whether an HTTPS request to the hostname reaches this Cactal domain, then returns the updated status. A customer CDN or reverse proxy in front is supported when it forwards the verification request to Cactal. `failureMessage` distinguishes a missing ownership record, an unreachable hostname, and a hostname served somewhere else. Cactal asks the domain nameservers directly, so new records usually count on the next check, and this endpoint is safe to poll; Cactal also re-checks pending domains automatically (every minute for the first 2 hours, every 5 minutes for the first day, then every 15 minutes). The first custom domain to become active is promoted to primary automatically.
name: websiteDomains_verifyCustomDomain
title: Verify a custom domain
